before: I study how precursor chemistry and confined vapour transport shape low-dimensional materials. My work connects close-space growth experiments with Raman and photoluminescence spectroscopy, collaborative characterisation, and Python analysis.
after: I study how precursor chemistry and confined vapour transport shape low-dimensional materials. My work connects close-space growth experiments with independent SEM/EDS characterisation, Raman and photoluminescence spectroscopy, and Python analysis.

before: I am a {{profile.role_short}} in the {{profile.group}} at {{profile.institution_short}}, working on tungsten oxides and transition-metal dichalcogenides. My doctoral research examines how source chemistry, source–substrate geometry and processing conditions influence material formation.

My approach combines controlled growth experiments with quantitative Raman/PL analysis and complementary evidence from collaborators. I also develop RamanPL_2D to turn spectroscopy datasets into fitted parameters, spatial maps and structured outputs.
Earlier work at Oxford connected photonic-device measurements with design and simulation. Alongside research, I have experience in technology assessment and deep-tech commercialisation.
after: I am a {{profile.role_short}} in the {{profile.group}} at {{profile.institution_short}}, working on tungsten oxides and transition-metal dichalcogenides. My doctoral research examines how source chemistry, source–substrate geometry and processing conditions influence material formation.

I combine controlled growth experiments with independent ex-situ SEM imaging, SEM-EDS elemental analysis and quantitative Raman/PL measurements. I also analyse collaborator-acquired operando SEM images and develop RamanPL_2D to turn spectroscopy datasets into fitted parameters, spatial maps and structured outputs.

Alongside research, I deliver practical SEM training to new PhD researchers, support student imaging projects and have demonstrated SEM to two NanoDTC cohorts. Earlier work at Oxford connected photonic-device measurements with design and simulation; my broader experience includes technology assessment and deep-tech commercialisation.

before: Raman/PL measurements and spatial mapping, interpreted alongside collaborative structural and chemical characterisation to connect processing with material response.
after: Independent SEM imaging and SEM-EDS elemental analysis, combined with Raman/PL mapping and collaborative structural and chemical evidence, connect processing conditions with morphology, composition and optical response.

before: How does a confined vapour geometry influence oxide and sulphide nanostructure formation?

I designed and conducted CSS-facilitated CVD growth and Raman/PL measurements, and co-wrote the first-author paper with Stephan Hofmann. The study connects precursor delivery and growth conditions with material formation.
Operando SEM, TEM/EDX and XPS measurements in this study were performed by collaborators.
after: How does a confined vapour geometry influence oxide and sulphide nanostructure formation?

I designed and conducted CSS-facilitated CVD growth and Raman/PL measurements, and co-wrote the first-author paper with Stephan Hofmann. My thesis also records my ex-situ SEM measurements and analysis of collaborator-acquired operando SEM images.
Operando SEM, TEM/EDX and XPS acquisition were performed by collaborators. Together, the growth and characterisation evidence links precursor delivery and growth conditions with material formation.

before: How can source treatment and source–substrate geometry guide planar WS₂ growth?
I investigated salt-assisted close-space growth using paired source–substrate analysis and Raman/PL measurements to examine precursor evolution alongside deposition outcomes.
This work forms part of my {{qualification:EDU-CAM:thesis}}; a first-author manuscript is {{status:P1:lower}}.
after: How can source treatment and source–substrate geometry guide planar WS₂ growth?

I investigated salt-assisted close-space growth through paired source–substrate analysis and Raman/PL measurements. I independently acquired SEM-EDS spectra and elemental maps on NaCl-treated SiO₂/Si controls to verify salt deposition before growth.
This work forms part of my {{qualification:EDU-CAM:thesis}}; a first-author manuscript is {{status:P1:lower}}.

before: How can spectroscopy assess the layer structure and optical response of directly written 2D material?

I contributed Raman and photoluminescence measurements and analysis to a collaborative closed-loop crystal-layer writing study. The growth platform and complementary measurements were led by other co-authors.
after: How can spectroscopy assess the layer structure and optical response of directly written 2D material?

I contributed Raman/PL measurements and mapping to a collaborative closed-loop MoS₂ writing study, assessing local variations in layer structure and optical response. Other co-authors led the growth platform and complementary measurements.
